The structure of Ho₂Si₆O₁₆ (reduced formula HoSi₃O₈) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with 24 atoms per unit cell distributed over seven independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Ho centers coordinated by eight O neighbors, while Si centers appear in two distinct octahedral environments with six O neighbors each. O centers have two or three geometric neighbors, one of which is Si. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 24 sites, and validated polyhedron contacts show corner- and edge-sharing between Si octahedra.
